sources.lighting: LORRI and MVIC panchromatic mosaic, 300 m/pixel at best on the encounter hemisphere and much coarser on the far side, with the source illumination; not calibrated albedo. sources.epoch: New Horizons flyby, 14 July 2015; USGS release July 2017
